environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (300s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~1.02e+05 timepoints (2p step, 204.812n window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 2.05e+03s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.
